baseline.notes: The existing curation layer remains available, but the research vault accepts broader and less normalized material. The second official-source pass added detailed overseas husbandry, health, enrichment and identity-correction records.

collection_principles: Separate primary evidence from secondary discovery leads.
Collect local media bytes regardless of rights state while preserving source, credit and rights metadata; keep binaries out of Git.
Keep all records local-only until a future publication decision.

targets: China Conservation and Research Center for the Giant Panda and its Wolong, Dujiangyan, Ya'an and Mianyang bases
Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding and Panda Valley
Beijing Zoo and major domestic holding institutions
studbook, research papers and historic rescue/release records
historic Ueno, Adventure World and Chiang Mai records
historic Zoo Atlanta and Memphis Zoo programmes
Chapultepec Zoo lineage and historic gift-panda records
Panda House Al Khor and Qatar official sources

next_collection_passes: Reconcile all 813 existing rows against primary individual or studbook sources.
Extract anecdotes, temperament, preferences, appearance and husbandry notes from official profile and news archives.
Build a complete dated movement history for every panda with facility-level provenance.
Capture all births, deaths, pregnancies, health events, naming events and public debuts.
Expand media-candidate discovery while recording file-level rights and identity confidence.
Record unresolved identities and contradictory dates without forcing premature merges.
